metadata.case_name: CHEUNG WAI PING v. CHAN YUEN YEE

injuries.description: A CT brain scan showed a left parietal epidural haematoma
source: A CT brain scan showed a left parietal epidural haematoma and traumatic sub-arachnoid haemorrhage.
A CT brain scan showed a left parietal epidural haematoma and traumatic sub-arachnoid haemorrhage.

injuries.description: There was a fracture of the left parietal bone.
source: There was a fracture of the left parietal bone.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of parietal bone of skull

injuries.description: right frontal and temporal lobe contusional haematoma
source: On the following day, on a finding of right frontal and temporal lobe contusional haematoma, another craniotomy was performed.

injuries.description: dementia due to head trauma; neurocognitive and neurobehavioural impairments
source: they found that he was free from psychiatric disorder before the accident but now suffers from dementia due to head trauma.
Dr Yu's opinion is that as a result of his severe head injury, the plaintiff experiences neurocognitive and neurobehavioural impairments...

injuries.body_part: left side upper and lower limbs
source: he had right side 3 rd nerve palsy and left side lower and upper limb weakness.
He found that the plaintiff suffered from residual cognitive dysfunction and left hemiparesis.
he had right side 3 rd nerve palsy and left side lower and upper limb weakness.
He was left with a depression in his skull for which it was suggested that he undergo cranioplasty, but he has not done so.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of vault of skull, unspecified

manifestations.description: dementia due to head trauma; moderate symptoms or moderate difficulty in social, occupational or school functioning
left hemiparesis / left side lower and upper limb weakness
doubly incontinent (at time of transfer to Cheshire Home)
needs accompaniment when he goes out and supervised when he takes medicine; cannot manage his family finances
able to walk slowly unaided with steady gait (by 24 March 2004)
needs standby assistance for climbing stairs and outdoor ambulation
unable to resume pre-accident or any employment; not fit for manual or sedentary job

treatments_future: ongoing psychiatric treatment for three years
neurological follow-up visits (disputed; limited allowance made)

losses.description: Irreparable brain damage causing inability to conduct his own affairs, very reduced cognitive function and gross disability (awarded under Pain, suffering and loss of amenity).
Loss of society to his wife (statutory claim under LARCO) assessed at middle of range given his dependent forgetful state.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Reduced ability to provide normal gratuitous services of a husband to his wife and family; requires care and supervision and cannot perform meaningful domestic tasks.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Suffers loss of interest in sex caused by the dementia.
He mainly keeps himself at home and does not have any interest in social activities; needs accompaniment when going out.
